name: tailscale-pam
description: Retired: jitd's MCP server (http://jit/mcp) needs no plugin. Run `claude mcp add --transport http --scope user jit http://jit/mcp` instead. This last release is only a pointer to that server, kept so existing installs keep working.

jit_url.title: jitd URL
jit_url.description: Where jitd answers on your tailnet. Change it only if jitd doesn't run as the machine named jit, for example http://jit-1 or http://access. The MCP server is at <this URL>/mcp.
